theme: Light theme default with earthy dark mode toggle

typography.rationale: Montserrat provides strong geometric, friendly headings and excellent Armenian character support. Noto Sans guarantees flawless bilingual rendering (Armenian + English) with high legibility for data-heavy dashboard tables.

colors.rules: Never use pure black or pure white in backgrounds. Tint greys with forest green. Ensure APCA contrast compliance, especially for Terracotta and Sage accents.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Clay & Crisp' Neumorphism. Cards should have soft ambient shadows (e.g., shadow-sm) but MUST have a sharp 1px border (border-border) to ground them.
visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle, semi-transparent borders using the border color defined above.
visual_enhancers.radius: Friendly and approachable: rounded-2xl for major cards/modals, rounded-xl for internal widgets, rounded-full for scout badges, avatars, and pill buttons.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle SVG noise overlay on the main background to break the 'digital flatness' and feel more tactile, like canvas or paper.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) for primary actions. Use interaction animations (scale down slightly on active).
components.cards: Flat background with 1px subtle border. On hover for interactive cards (like programs or members): slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-md.
components.badges: For scout progress badges, use physical patch aesthetics: rounded-full, heavy inner shadow (shadow-inner), and a thicker 2px border matching the secondary color.
components.progress_bars: Thick (h-4 or h-6), rounded-full, utilizing the primary Terracotta color for fill and muted stone grey for track. Add a subtle shine effect or gradient to the fill.
components.tables: Stripped back borders. Use 'High Density' grid rules. Alternating row backgrounds using the muted color with very low opacity.
components.navigation: Sidebar for the dashboard (Admin/Scouts). The sidebar must be deep forest green (#1B4332) with warm sand text, providing a strong anchor for the earthy layout. NEVER use a transparent header.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_scout: MODE A (The Bento Grid): For scout-facing views (My Progress, Badges). Highly visual, asymmetric. Mix large hero cards with smaller stat squares. Generous gap-6 or gap-8.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_admin: MODE B (High Density Grid): For Admin panels and Member Databases. Dense, functional, gap-4. Utilize max screen real-estate.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Default padding for cards is p-6 or p-8. Empty space is valued.

motion.interactions: All buttons and interactive cards must have hover states (color shift, slight lift) and active/press states (scale-down).
motion.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in for dashboard widgets using framer-motion. Items should slide up slightly (y: 10 to y: 0) with opacity fade.
motion.rules: Transitions must be specific (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease) NOT 'transition: all'. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Text over the Terracotta primary button must be White. Text over the Forest Green sidebar must be Warm Sand (#F4F1EA).
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements, forms, links, and major data points MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='scout-login-button').
accessibility.bilingual: UI must accommodate variable text lengths, as Armenian translations may be longer or shorter than English. Do not use fixed heights for text containers.

media.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for clean, consistent interface icons. Use heavily across the sidebar and table actions.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a multi-role scouting platform. It must feel like an outdoor adventure tool, not a corporate CRM.
Implement a persistent deep forest green sidebar with off-white active states.
Implement bilingual support structures (use a simple mock translation or layout that supports Armenian).
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize their border radius (rounded-2xl) and remove standard grey shadows in favor of subtle tinted shadows.
Build the 'Progress Badges' module as circular UI elements with inner shadows to simulate embroidered patches.
Do NOT center align the app container. No '.App { text-align: center; }'.
NEVER use generic placeholder text or dummy image APIs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Include data-testid attributes on all interactive elements.
Provide a Base64 image storage mock/utility if implementing actual file uploads for Resources or Profile images.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: 'transition: all'. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on provided image URLs. Missing categories = placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner components are located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or similar path.
